name: Spanish Vegetable Paella
ingredients: ¼ cup short-grain brown rice, rinsed
1 red bell pepper, 1 cup green beans and 1 tomato, chopped
½ onion and 3 garlic cloves, chopped
1 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of saffron or ½ tsp turmeric
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook the onion for 4 minutes. Add the garlic, pepper and green beans and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the tomato, paprika and saffron and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice and chickpeas, then pour in the stock. Do not stir again.
Simmer gently, uncovered, for 35 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with lemon and parsley.
note: The chickpea-rich version keeps the rice portion small; brown rice takes longer than paella rice.
